# DataSharedLib - LLM Prompt Context
Framework: .NET 10 (`net10.0`), C# 13
Package: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 5.2.2

Key Components:
- Connection/ (IDatabaseConnectionFactory, DatabaseConnectionFactory, DatabaseConnectionOptions)
- Services/ (IDatabaseQueryService, IDatabaseCrudService, IDatabaseBulkService, IStoredProcedureService)
- Models/Requests/ & Models/Responses/
- Validation/ (IRequestValidator, RequestValidator)
- Exceptions/ (DatabaseException, ConnectionException, ExecutionException)
- Configuration/ (ServiceCollectionExtensions)

AI Agent Rules:
- All SQL parameterized.
- Identifiers regex-sanitized.
- Async I/O with CancellationToken.
